newsitem.title: USA: HP reviews costs after weak Q2 revenue, profit rise.
newsitem.headline: HP reviews costs after weak Q2 revenue, profit rise.

text.p: Hewlett-Packard Co. Chief Financial Officer Robert Wayman said the company is reviewing spending plans to keep expenses in control after lower-than-expected second quarter revenue and orders growth.

Wayman said the company's expense management remained a priority, although the company's profit growth in the second quarter despite the soft order and revenue growth demonstrated that the company could manage in "less robust" markets.
Wayman said the company will introduce aggressive new products in the second half of its fiscal year, including new high-end servers it plans to unveil on May 22.
